title: Little Workers: Bees
subtitle: 考点：蜜蜂与授粉 / connect / communicate
passage: Bees are tiny, but they play an important role in nature. When a bee visits a flower, some pollen sticks to its body. When it flies to the next flower, the pollen goes with it. This is called pollination. Without pollination, many plants cannot make fruit or seeds.

Bees live in groups and work together. Some bees look for flowers, and some stay in the hive to make honey. A bee that finds good flowers can communicate with other bees by dancing. The dance tells them where the flowers are.

People get honey and honeycomb from bees, but the greatest gift of bees is pollination. Scientists say that one third of the food we eat is connected with bees. If bees disappear, our food will change. For this reason, we should plant more flowers and not use too many chemicals in gardens.
